manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: Compare a tossed ball with a dropped ball to see why acceleration remains nonzero at the apex.
manifest.description: Two side-by-side vertical lanes show a tossed ball and a dropped ball. Velocity and acceleration vectors display how gravity continuously acts on both.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. At each pause, compare velocity and acceleration.
